tasks.title: Scaffold the hookgate crate
tasks.description: Create crates/hookgate with a manifest that declares dependencies directly (main has no [workspace.dependencies]), features default = [presets] and presets = [], the workspace-inherited edition, rust-version, licence, and repository fields, the licence files, a README, and a lib.rs carrying forbid(unsafe_code), deny(missing_docs), and crate docs that state the raw-body rule and the non-goals. Confirm the workspace resolves the new member.

tasks.title: Implement core types and the redacting error type
tasks.description: Implement types.rs with DeliveryId, IdempotencyKey, InboundRequest holding the raw body as Bytes, VerifiedEvent, DeliveryRecord, InsertOutcome, and DeadLetterRecord. Implement error.rs with HookgateError and a redact_error helper so no signature, shared secret, or credential material can render in Debug, Display, a log, or an error payload.

tasks.title: Implement the Verifier trait over raw bytes
tasks.description: Implement verify/mod.rs: the Verifier trait, constant-time comparison via subtle, and failure that closes on a mismatch. Verification must compute the signature over the exact received bytes and must never parse and re-serialize the body first. Bound and validate the input so an oversized or malformed request is a typed error rather than a panic.

tasks.title: Enforce the timestamp tolerance
tasks.description: Add the received-at and signature-timestamp comparison so a request whose timestamp is outside the configurable skew is rejected as stale rather than accepted. The verifier takes its secret from the caller and reads nothing from the environment.

tasks.title: Implement the provider verifier presets
tasks.description: Behind the presets feature, implement verifiers for Meta (X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC-SHA256), Stripe (Stripe-Signature with timestamp tolerance), Shopify (X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 base64), Twilio (X-Twilio-Signature HMAC-SHA1 over URL plus sorted params), Slack (v0 versioned HMAC-SHA256), and GitHub (X-Hub-Signature-256), each over the raw received bytes.

tasks.title: Add the generic HMAC verifier and gate the presets
tasks.description: Add a configurable generic HMAC verifier accepting the caller's header name, encoding, and prefix so an unlisted provider is covered. Ensure the presets feature is additive and that a build without it still exposes the core types, traits, and memory store while omitting every preset.

tasks.title: Define DeliveryStore and Outbox
tasks.description: Define the DeliveryStore trait with insert_if_new returning an InsertOutcome, mark_processed, and mark_failed, and the Outbox trait with enqueue. State on the contract that the delivery record and the outbox entry are both written before success is reported, so a crash after acknowledgement leaves the event recoverable.

tasks.title: Implement MemoryDeliveryStore with tenant-scoped dedupe
tasks.description: Implement memory.rs. insert_if_new is idempotent per tenant and event id and returns Duplicate for a repeat, and the uniqueness key includes the tenant so the same event id from two tenants is not a duplicate. Every read and write is scoped by the tenant, so no tenant can observe another's delivery.

tasks.title: Add dead-letter capture and idempotent replay
tasks.description: Record a failed delivery as a DeadLetterRecord carrying its raw body, reason, and attempt count, and make replaying it idempotent against the delivery store so a poison delivery is recoverable rather than blocking the outbox.

tasks.title: Wire the crate, document it, and run the verification checks
tasks.description: Confirm the workspace resolves the new member; write the README covering the ingress flow, the raw-body rule, and the presets; ensure every public item carries rustdoc and every module states scope and non-goals; confirm the crate contains no provider client, outbound HTTP call, HTTP server, or axum integration, and no product vocabulary. Then run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo doc --workspace --all-features --no-deps with RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings, cargo check -p hookgate --no-default-features, and node .sdrive/scripts/validate-governance.js. Test authoring and execution are the test agent's responsibility and are not part of this phase.
